import random

rng = random.Random(20260926)
n = 40000
a = [rng.randint(0, 100) for _ in range(n)]
labels = list(range(1, n + 1))
rng.shuffle(labels)
edges = []
for i in range(1, n):
    p = rng.randrange(max(0, i - 50), i)
    u, v = labels[i], labels[p]
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        u, v = v, u
    edges.append((u, v, rng.randint(1, 100)))
rng.shuffle(edges)
out = [str(n), ' '.join(map(str, a))]
out.extend(f'{u} {v} {w}' for u, v, w in edges)
print('\n'.join(out))
